description: The second claim cites [3], but only sources 1 and 2 were supplied. A marker that resolves to nothing is not a citation.
response: Northwind Bank announced a core banking migration on 2026-02-11 [1]. The programme is budgeted at 40 million dollars over three years [3].

notes: Fabricating a marker is cheaper for a model than fabricating a document, so this failure is common.
